Equipment:

Oil Pumps Control 
 for Unit 10
MHY
CCCP
Introduction

This document lists the equipment inspection I1, to be performed on an annually 
bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block

Two pumps one in auto position the other inres 
 position the auto one works when oil pressure in the accumulator goes down 
 to 37 kg / cm2 and stops at 40 kg / cm2 .
The reserve pump works at 34 kg/cm2 and stops at 40 kg/cm2.

The pressure oil used through speed governor actuator to open and close two 
servomotors which they open and close the wicket gates.

The first draft initiated & tested by eng. Mohamed Shaaban Al-Behairy, 
 accepted by general director eng. Selem Ahmed Aly, approved by eng. 
 Abd El-kreem Abu Zaid: head 
 sector of High Dam Power Station, and certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb: HPGC 
quality control general director.

Safety 
Precautions

A 
work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with 
caution marks surrounding the work area.
Wear safety helmet, shoes, belts, work gloves
